articles.title: Lombard joins LayerZero exodus as $4 billion in assets switch to Chainlink's bridge
articles.snippet: The shift comes after the Kelp DAO exploit drained $292 million from its LayerZero-powered bridge, increasing concerns over the security of cross-chain infrastructure.

articles.title: Thorchain halts trading after $10 million cross-chain exploit, RUNE token drops 12%
articles.snippet: The cross-chain liquidity protocol paused all trading and signing on Friday after an attacker drained roughly $10.8 million across Bitcoin, Ethereum, BSC, and Base.

articles.title: THORChain pauses trading after suspected $10M exploit
articles.snippet: THORChain paused trading after ZachXBT flagged a suspected $10 million exploit spanning Bitcoin, Ethereum, BNB Chain and Base.

articles.title: Kraken joins LayerZero exodus as it switches to Chainlink CCIP
articles.snippet: LayerZero has come under scrutiny since it was exploited in April, as crypto protocols reevaluate their cross-chain providers and seek safer alternatives.

articles.title: THORChain’s RUNE Token Plunges Double Digits After $10M Exploit, Trading Halt
articles.snippet: The liquidity protocol halted operations after blockchain researchers identified a suspected $10 million breach across multiple networks.
